question: 為什麼在這個職涯階段報考培訓機師？
question_en: Why are you applying for cadet pilot training at this stage of your career?
answer: I would explain my understanding of the career, my preparation and my ability to commit. Age alone does not prove maturity; concrete actions and readiness matter more.
